description: This file defines the SimpleTaskSupport enum with static methods to manage asynchronous tasks, including starting, stopping, and creating detached loops for repeated asynchronous operations.

classes.name: SimpleTaskSupport
classes.description: An enum acting as a namespace for static methods to control asynchronous task operations such as starting, stopping, and running detached loops.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts a new asynchronous task executing the provided operation if no task is currently running.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Cancels the given task and sets it to nil.

methods.name: startDetachedLoop
methods.description: Creates a detached task that repeatedly executes the specified operation at the given time interval until cancelled.
